sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策报道记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上免费直播部分精选访谈，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费全站新闻阅读权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, in an interview with The Times, President Trump gives his account of a previously undisclosed conversation with Vladimir Putin
sentences.zh: 今天，特朗普总统在接受《时报》采访时，讲述了他与弗拉基米尔·普京先前未曾公开的一次谈话，

sentences.en: and expresses his anger towards key figures in the Russia investigation, including his own attorney general.
sentences.zh: 并表达了他对俄罗斯调查中关键人物的愤怒，其中包括他自己的司法部长。

sentences.en: He never would have appointed Jeff Sessions, he says, if he knew then what he knows now.
sentences.zh: 他表示，如果早知道现在的情况，他绝不会任命杰夫·塞申斯。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, July 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月20日，星期四。

sentences.en: On Wednesday afternoon, my colleagues Peter Baker, Michael Schmidt, and Maggie Haberman interviewed President Trump in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 周三下午，我的同事彼得·贝克、迈克尔·施密特和玛吉·哈伯曼在椭圆形办公室采访了特朗普总统。

sentences.en: The president was running late.
sentences.zh: 总统当时迟到了。

sentences.en: We were sitting outside the Oval Office, and we see the president come down through the Rose Garden with Vice President Pence and walk up.
sentences.zh: 我们正坐在椭圆形办公室外面，看到总统和彭斯副总统穿过玫瑰园走过来。

sentences.en: He had just had lunch with Republican senators about health care, and he walks in, and a few moments later, his aide comes out and says, it's time to see the president.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚和共和党参议员吃完关于医疗保健的午餐，他走了进来，片刻之后，他的助手出来说，可以去见总统了。

sentences.en: Hi, fellas.
sentences.zh: 嗨，伙计们。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你们好吗？

sentences.en: Good, good.
sentences.zh: 很好，很好。

sentences.en: Hard to watch?
sentences.zh: 很难看吗？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: It was good.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.en: I mean, we're very close.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们非常接近了。

sentences.en: It's tough.
sentences.zh: 这很难。

sentences.en: You know, health care.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，医疗保健。

sentences.en: Look.
sentences.zh: 听着。

sentences.en: Maggie, what did the president say about the collapse of the health care bill in the interview?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，在采访中，总统对医改法案的搁浅是怎么说的？

sentences.en: The president seemed very aware that health care has not gotten done, and that it was something that he had promised during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 总统似乎非常清楚医改没有通过，这是他在竞选期间承诺过的事情。

sentences.en: He referenced that a few times.
sentences.zh: 他提到了好几次。

sentences.en: He said, you know, made the point of mentioning that Congress has promised it for a while, the Republicans in Congress.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他特别指出国会已经承诺这件事一段时间了，国会中的共和党人。

sentences.en: And he raised the fact that Barack Obama took, you know, 13 months, close to 14 months to get his bill passed.
sentences.zh: 他还提到，巴拉克·奥巴马花了，你知道的，13个月，将近14个月才让他的法案通过。

sentences.en: He raised the fact that Hillary Clinton was the wife of a sitting president with a Democratic-controlled Congress,
sentences.zh: 他提到希拉里·克林顿是一位在任总统的妻子，当时国会由民主党控制，

sentences.en: and she couldn't get anything done.
sentences.zh: 而她什么也没能办成。

sentences.en: When you think of Hillary Clinton, and you look, she went eight years, very capable, went eight years as the First Lady, and could not get health care.
sentences.zh: 当你想到希拉里·克林顿，你看，她当了八年第一夫人，能力很强，却没能搞定医疗改革。

sentences.en: Almost as if the benchmark that he should be judged by, that it shouldn't be.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像是他用来衡量自己的基准，本不该是这样的。

sentences.en: In other words, that we shouldn't be judging the president on the fact that he wasn't able to get health care done in just six months.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，我们不应该因为总统在短短六个月内未能通过医改而对他横加指责。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: As if these things take a long time and they are complicated, I think that this was something that he felt was important for us to remember.
sentences.zh: 就好像这些事情需要很长时间而且很复杂，我认为这是他觉得我们需要记住的重要一点。

sentences.en: But this is despite the fact that he repeatedly said that as soon as he came in, he would have the answer to health care.
sentences.zh: 但尽管他曾多次表示，他一上台就会有解决医疗保健问题的方案。

sentences.en: So this is a new argument, which is, instead of, I'm going to fix this off the bat, health care is hard.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个新论点，那就是，与其说“我会马上解决”，不如说“医改很难”。

sentences.en: It's a very narrow path, winding this way.
sentences.zh: 这是一条非常狭窄、蜿蜒曲折的道路。

sentences.en: You get, you think you have it, and then you lose four on the other side because you get to, it is a, it is a brutal process.
sentences.zh: 你以为你拿下了，然后另一边又跑了四个，因为你到了……这是一个极其残酷的过程。

sentences.en: And it was for the Democrats in all fairness.
sentences.zh: 平心而论，对民主党人来说也是如此。

sentences.en: Okay, so, Maggie, we reported a couple of days ago that at the G20 summit last week, the president had a second undisclosed conversation with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么，玛吉，我们在几天前报道过，在上周的G20峰会上，总统与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行了第二次未公开的谈话。

sentences.en: How does that come up in the interview?
sentences.zh: 这在采访中是怎么被提起?

sentences.en: So, Peter Baker, our colleague, asked the question.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们的同事彼得·贝克提出了这个问题。

sentences.en: I'm a little curious about your extra conversation with the president at dinner.
sentences.zh: 我对你在晚宴上和总统的额外谈话有点好奇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Not some surprising, but it didn't, what did y'all talk about it?
sentences.zh: 不算太惊讶，但并没有……你们聊了些什么？

sentences.en: About this meeting and what had transpired.
sentences.zh: 关于这次会面以及发生的事情。

sentences.en: And the president was clearly irritated that it had become a big fire.
sentences.zh: 总统显然很恼火，因为这成了一件大风波。

sentences.en: He said he had been sitting with Prime Minister Abe's wife.
sentences.zh: 他说他当时坐在安倍首相的妻子旁边。

sentences.en: And she's a terrific woman, but doesn't speak English.
sentences.zh: 她是个了不起的女性，但不会说英语。

sentences.en: Like nothing, right?
sentences.zh: 就像完全不会，对吧？

sentences.en: It's zero.
sentences.zh: 完全是零。

sentences.en: Like not hello.
sentences.zh: 连一句你好都不会。

sentences.en: That must make for an awkward seating.
sentences.zh: 那座位安排一定很尴尬吧。

sentences.en: Well, it's hard because, you know, you're sitting for hours.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很难，你知道的，你要坐上好几个小时。

sentences.en: It lasted.
sentences.zh: 持续了很久。

sentences.en: So the dinner was probably an hour and 45 minutes.
sentences.zh: 所以晚宴大概持续了一个小时四十五分钟。

sentences.en: He described it in a very lighthearted way as something that was just kind of offhand.
sentences.zh: 他以一种非常轻松的方式将其描述为一件随口聊聊的事情。

sentences.en: So we're sitting at this massive table and the wives are separated from the housewives, which sometimes they do, sometimes they don't, but they didn't.
sentences.zh: 所以我们坐在巨大的桌子旁，夫人们和家属们是分开的，有时他们这样做，有时不这样，但这次他们没有分开。

sentences.en: And it's always easier when they don't do it.
sentences.zh: 不分开的话总是更容易交流。

sentences.en: You always have somebody to talk to.
sentences.zh: 你总能找到人聊天。

sentences.en: At some point, he got up to go talk to his own wife.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，他起身去跟自己的妻子讲话。

sentences.en: And now Melania was sitting on the other side of the table, way down on the other end, very far away.
sentences.zh: 而梅拉尼娅当时坐在桌子的另一边，很远的那一头，离得非常远。

sentences.en: She was sitting next to Putin and somebody else.
sentences.zh: 她坐在普京和另外一个人旁边。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: She was sitting next to Putin.
sentences.zh: 她就坐在普京旁边。

sentences.en: She had been the whole time or she had been?
sentences.zh: 她一直都在那儿还是后来才去的？

sentences.en: The whole time.
sentences.zh: 一直都在。

sentences.en: No, she was sitting next to Putin.
sentences.zh: 不，她一直坐在普京旁边。

sentences.en: Does she speak Russian at all?
sentences.zh: 她会说俄语吗？

sentences.en: No, it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 不，不会。

sentences.en: It speaks other languages.
sentences.zh: 她会说其他语言。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Which we were curious about because she's from Eastern Europe.
sentences.zh: 我们对此很好奇，因为她来自东欧。

sentences.en: So she's sitting next to Putin and somebody else.
sentences.zh: 所以她坐在普京和另外一个人旁边。

sentences.en: And that's the way it is.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: So the meal is going through.
sentences.zh: 于是晚宴继续进行。

sentences.en: And toward dessert, I went down just to say hello to Melania.
sentences.zh: 快到吃甜点的时候，我走过去跟梅拉尼娅打招呼。

sentences.en: And while I was there, I said hello to Putin.
sentences.zh: 我在那儿的时候，也跟普京打了个招呼。

sentences.en: Really pleasantries more than anything else.
sentences.zh: 与其说是别的，不如说是寒暄。

sentences.en: It was not a long conversation, but it was, you know, it could be 15 minutes, just talked about things.
sentences.zh: 这不是一次长谈，但你知道的，可能持续了15分钟，只是聊了一些事情。

sentences.en: He basically described it as essentially chit-chat, that they were just sort of talking.
sentences.zh: 他基本上将其描述为闲聊，他们只是随便聊聊。

sentences.en: Putin and Trump just chit-chatting.
sentences.zh: 普京和特朗普只是在闲聊。

sentences.en: Putin and Trump just chit-chatting.
sentences.zh: 普京和特朗普只是在闲聊。

sentences.en: Actually, it was very interesting.
sentences.zh: 其实，这非常有趣。

sentences.en: We talked about adoption.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到了收养问题。

sentences.en: You did?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Russian adoption.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯收养。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I always found that interesting because, you know, he ended that years ago.
sentences.zh: 我一直觉得这很有趣，因为你知道，他几年前就结束了这件事。

sentences.en: And I actually talked about Russian adoption with him, which is interesting because that was a part of a conversation that Don had with this meeting.
sentences.zh: 我实际上和他谈过俄罗斯收养的事，这很有趣，因为那是唐那次会面谈话的一部分。

sentences.en: And what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, what he means is the policy that was changed to bar American families from adopting
sentences.zh: 嗯，他的意思是那项被修改的政策，禁止美国家庭收养

sentences.en: Russian children, which was done in response to sanctions that were signed called the Magnitsky
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯儿童，这是为了回应被称为《马格尼茨基法案》的

sentences.en: Act.
sentences.zh: 制裁措施而做出的。

sentences.en: And what was interesting about that is the Magnitsky Act was initially described as the focus of a meeting that Trump's son, Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，《马格尼茨基法案》最初被描述为特朗普的儿子小唐

sentences.en: had with a Russian lawyer on June 9th,
sentences.zh: 在2016年6月9日

sentences.en: 2016 at Trump Tower that we have come to learn was actually initially advertised as a meeting about potential dirt on Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 于特朗普大厦与一名俄罗斯律师会面的焦点，而我们后来得知，该会面最初其实是以讨论关于希拉里·克林顿的潜在黑料为幌子宣传的。

sentences.en: You know, when they call up and they say, by the way, we have information on your opponent.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当他们打电话来说，顺便问一下，我们有关于你对手的信息。

sentences.en: I think most politicians, I was just with a lot of people, they said, who wouldn't have taken a meeting like that?
sentences.zh: 我想大多数政治家——我刚刚和很多人在一起——他们说，谁不会接受这样的会面呢？

sentences.en: They just said, a lot of them.
sentences.zh: 他们只是说，很多人都会。

sentences.en: They said, who wouldn't have taken a meeting like that?
sentences.zh: 他们说，谁不会接受这样的会面呢？

sentences.en: And that was before Russia...
sentences.zh: 那是在俄罗斯……之前。

sentences.en: So, Maggie, do we think that there's any connection between the fact that adoption was discussed in that meeting with Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 所以，玛吉，我们认为在与小唐的那个会面中讨论收养问题

sentences.en: and the fact that Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump now are talking about it in their face-to-face meeting we didn't know about?
sentences.zh: 和弗拉基米尔·普京与唐纳德·特朗普现在在我们所不知道的面对面会谈中讨论这件事之间，有什么联系吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: And I'm really hesitant to speculate just given how little we know about this meeting.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们对这次会面知之甚少，我真的很犹豫不做过多猜测。

sentences.en: But if it did come up and it didn't necessarily have to be in connection with Don Jr., you know, it's really a meeting that's about sanctions.
sentences.zh: 但如果它确实被提及了，而且不一定非得与小唐有关，你知道的，这其实是一场关于制裁的会面。

sentences.en: And so if that was raised, that's a little more than idle chit-chat.
sentences.zh: 所以如果提出了这一点，那就不仅仅是无聊的闲聊了。

sentences.en: It's just this odd coincidence that we weren't able to make sense of in real time and are still not quite sure about.
sentences.zh: 这只是一种奇怪的巧合，我们在当时没能理清头绪，现在也依然不太确定。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Mike, I imagine you're especially interested in speaking to the president about James Comey, the former FBI director, and the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 迈克，我想你对跟总统谈论詹姆士·科米这位前联邦调查局局长以及俄罗斯调查一定特别感兴趣。

sentences.en: For some time, I'd been trying, you know, along with my colleagues, to get in front of the president and try and learn more about the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，我一直和我的同事们试图接触总统，并试图了解更多关于俄罗斯调查的信息。

sentences.en: This is a massive cloud over his presidency.
sentences.zh: 这对他的总统任期来说是一片巨大的阴云。

sentences.en: And this is a president who likes to use on-the-record interviews to either clear things up or make points.
sentences.zh: 而这位总统喜欢利用公开采访来澄清事情或表达观点。

sentences.en: And this is certainly an incredibly hot issue.
sentences.zh: 这无疑是一个极其敏感的话题。

sentences.en: And I wanted to get in front of him to talk about that.
sentences.zh: 我想当面找他谈谈这个。

sentences.en: What happens there in the interview?
sentences.zh: 采访中发生了什么？

sentences.en: Trump addresses a January 6 interaction he had with Comey.
sentences.zh: 特朗普谈到了他与科米在1月6日的互动。

sentences.en: Comey and the head of the CIA, the head of the NSA, and the director of national intelligence went to Trump Tower in January to brief Trump on the Russian meddling in the election.
sentences.zh: 科米与中情局局长、国安局局长以及国家情报总监于1月前往特朗普大厦，向特朗普简要汇报了俄罗斯干预大选的情况。

sentences.en: After that meeting, Comey pulled Trump aside and told him about the dossier.
sentences.zh: 会后，科米把特朗普拉到一边，向他讲述了那份档案。

sentences.en: This is this document compiled by a former British spy who's deeply sourced in Russia and has these very salacious allegations about Trump in it.
sentences.zh: 这是一份由前英国间谍编制的文件，该间谍在俄罗斯有着深厚的人脉，其中包含关于特朗普的非常耸人听闻的指控。

sentences.en: I didn't know what to think other than this is really phony stuff.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么想，只觉得这纯粹是假东西。

sentences.en: Why do you think he, why do you think he shared it?
sentences.zh: 你认为他，你认为他为什么要分享这个？

sentences.en: And what Trump says when asked about this is that, in my opinion, he shared it so that I would think he had it out there as leverage.
sentences.zh: 当被问及此事时，特朗普表示，依我之见，他分享这个是为了让我认为他手里握有这个作为筹码。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think so.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也这么认为。

sentences.en: In retrospect, in retrospect.
sentences.zh: 事后看来，事后看来。

sentences.en: What Comey has said is that he told Trump this because Trump had a right to know that this
sentences.zh: 科米所说的是，他把这件事告诉了特朗普，是因为特朗普有权知道外面有关于他们的这种言论

sentences.en: was out there about them and that the FBI was learning or afraid that a media organization was going to write about it.
sentences.zh: 并且联邦调查局正在获悉或担心某家媒体机构会对此进行报道。

sentences.en: But from Trump's perspective, this was sort of like, you know, hey, look at what we've got.
sentences.zh: 但在特朗普看来，这有点像，你知道的，“嘿，看看我们拿到了什么。”

sentences.en: So were you surprised by anything the president had to say on this topic of Comey and the Russia investigation?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于总统在科米和俄罗斯调查这个话题上所说的话，有什么让你感到惊讶的吗？

sentences.en: And was any of it in contradiction, Mike, to your reporting?
sentences.zh: 迈克，其中是否有任何内容与你的报道相矛盾？

sentences.en: Well, certainly the biggest thing that the president refuted is this February 14th meeting that Comey has testified he had with Trump.
sentences.zh: 当然，总统反驳的最大的一点就是科米作证说他与特朗普进行过这次2月14日的会面。

sentences.en: This is where Trump kicks everyone out of the room and corners Comey as Comey sits at the resolute desk in the same chair as we were in today.
sentences.zh: 这就是特朗普把所有人赶出房间，把科米逼到角落的那次，当时科米坐在坚毅桌旁，坐在我们今天坐的那把椅子上。

sentences.en: And Trump says to him, I need you to move beyond the Flynn investigation.
sentences.zh: 特朗普对他说：“我需要你放过对弗林的调查。”

sentences.en: I need you to end the investigation of my former national security advisor.
sentences.zh: “我需要你结束对我前国家安全顾问的调查。”

sentences.en: And Trump says he has no recollection of that.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普表示他对此毫无印象。

sentences.en: Did you shoo other people out of the room when you talked to Comey that time of the day?
sentences.zh: 那天你和科米谈话时，真的把其他人赶出房间了吗？

sentences.en: No, I didn't.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有。

sentences.en: That was the other thing.
sentences.zh: 那是另一回事。

sentences.en: I told people to get out of the room.
sentences.zh: 我叫人们离开房间。

sentences.en: Why would I do that?
sentences.zh: 我为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: Did you actually have a one-on-one with Comey that day?
sentences.zh: 那天你真的和科米进行了一对一的谈话吗？

sentences.en: Not much.
sentences.zh: 没怎么谈。

sentences.en: Not even that I remember.
sentences.zh: 甚至连这件事我都不记得了。

sentences.en: He was sitting and I don't remember even talking to him about any of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 他当时坐着，而且我甚至不记得曾跟他谈过任何这些乱七八糟的事。

sentences.en: He said I asked people to go.
sentences.zh: 他说我要求人们离开。

sentences.en: Look, you look at his testimony.
sentences.zh: 听着，你们去看看他的证词。

sentences.en: His testimony is loaded up with lies.
sentences.zh: 他的证词里充满了谎言。

sentences.en: So that's a direct contradiction to Comey's account.
sentences.zh: 所以这与科米的说法直接矛盾。

sentences.en: Now, the interesting thing, if you're Bob Mueller, the special prosecutor, and you're investigating this, there were a lot of people that got kicked out of the room, the attorney
sentences.zh: 现在，有趣的是，如果你是特别检察官鲍勃·穆勒，而你正在调查这件事，当时有很多人被请出了房间，总检察长

sentences.en: general, the vice president, the chief of staff, other aides.
sentences.zh: 副总统、幕僚长和其他助手。

sentences.en: Witnesses to it, right.
sentences.zh: 有目击者，对吧。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So if you're Mueller, you'll be able to figure out whether there was a one-on-one because those folks will be able to tell you in an interview what happened, not what happened
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是穆勒，你就能弄清楚是否进行过单独会面，因为那些人在接受采访时会告诉你发生了什么，不是指房间里

sentences.en: in the room, but whether this meeting actually happened, which Trump is raising questions about.
sentences.zh: 发生了什么，而是这次会面是否真的发生过，而特朗普对此提出了质疑。

sentences.en: And the president said explicitly that James Comey lies.
sentences.zh: 总统明确表示詹姆斯·科米在说谎。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He says that Comey lies in his testimony, that Comey illegally leaked information about his interactions with Trump.
sentences.zh: 他说科米在证词中撒了谎，说科米非法泄露了他与特朗普互动的信息。

sentences.en: He leaked.
sentences.zh: 他泄密了。

sentences.en: The reason he leaked, so he illegally leaked.
sentences.zh: 他泄密的原因，也就是他进行了非法泄密。

sentences.en: And that Comey just cooked all this stuff up about him as part of a larger conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 并且科米凭空捏造了关于他的这一切，作为更大阴谋的一部分。

sentences.en: So, Maggie and Mike, you both asked repeatedly about special prosecutor Robert Mueller, who's leading the Russia investigation into the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 所以，玛吉和迈克，你们俩都曾反复追问关于特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒的事情，他正在领导针对特朗普政府的俄罗斯调查。

sentences.en: What would cause you, what would be the line beyond which, if Mueller went, you would say that's too far, we would need to dismiss him?
sentences.zh: 是什么会促使你，如果穆勒越过了哪条红线，你会说这太过分了，我们必须解雇他？

sentences.en: Look, there's so many conflicts that everybody has.
sentences.zh: 听着，每个人身上都有太多的利益冲突。

sentences.en: What did President Trump say about special prosecutor Mueller?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统对特别检察官穆勒说了什么？

sentences.en: He said a number of things, but one of the things he talked about is something that White
sentences.zh: 他说了很多事情，其中他谈到的一点是白宫助手们

sentences.en: House aides have mentioned for several weeks in frustration, which is that they say that Robert
sentences.zh: 几周来一直感到沮丧而提及的事情，也就是他们说罗伯特

sentences.en: Mueller had interviewed for interim FBI director.
sentences.zh: 穆勒曾面试过联邦调查局代理局长的职位。

sentences.en: Did you know Mueller was one of the people that was being interviewed?
sentences.zh: 你知道穆勒是接受面试的人选之一吗？

sentences.en: I did, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实我知道。

sentences.en: He was sitting in that chair.
sentences.zh: 他当时就坐在那把椅子上。

sentences.en: We had a wonderful meeting.
sentences.zh: 我们有过一次非常愉快的会面。

sentences.en: The day before, right?
sentences.zh: 就前一天，对吧？

sentences.en: Did he want the job?
sentences.zh: 他想要这份工作吗？

sentences.en: The day before.
sentences.zh: 就在前一天。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: He was up here.
sentences.zh: 他当时来过这儿。

sentences.en: Mueller wanted the job.
sentences.zh: 穆勒想要这份工作。

sentences.en: So after Comey had been fired?
sentences.zh: 所以在科米被解职之后？

sentences.en: After Comey had been fired.
sentences.zh: 在科米被解职之后。

sentences.en: He said, what the hell is this all about?
sentences.zh: 他说，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: You're talking about conflicts.
sentences.zh: 你们在谈论利益冲突。

sentences.en: He was interviewing for the job.
sentences.zh: 他当时正在为这份工作接受面试。

sentences.en: He described it as, you know, Mueller having conflicts.
sentences.zh: 他把这描述为，你知道的，穆勒存在利益冲突。

sentences.en: That was clearly one of them in his mind.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，这显然是其中之一。

sentences.en: Because, so what he's saying is because Mueller had come in and potentially viewed himself as a candidate to be interim FBI director, that that was disqualifying to investigate
sentences.zh: 因为，他要表达的意思是，由于穆勒曾进来过，并且可能将自己视为联邦调查局代理局长的候选人，因此他没有资格调查

sentences.en: the president on Russia.
sentences.zh: 总统与俄罗斯的关系。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If Mueller was looking at your finances, your family's finances, unrelated to Russia, is that a red line?
sentences.zh: 如果穆勒在审查你的财务状况、你家人的财务状况，与俄罗斯无关，那这也是一条红线吗？

sentences.en: Would that be a breach of what his actual...
sentences.zh: 这会违背他实际的……

sentences.en: I would say yes.
sentences.zh: 我会说是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I would say yes.
sentences.zh: 对，我会说是的。

sentences.en: By the way...
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句……

sentences.en: The president clearly sees the Mueller investigation as one that should be focused on Russia.
sentences.zh: 总统显然认为对穆勒的调查应该聚焦于俄罗斯。

sentences.en: But if he was outside that lane, would that mean he'd have to go?
sentences.zh: 但如果他越过了那个界限，是否意味着他必须走人？

sentences.en: Would you be...
sentences.zh: 你会……

sentences.en: No, I think that's a violation.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为那是一种违规。

sentences.en: Look, this is about Russia.
sentences.zh: 听着，这是关于俄罗斯的。

sentences.en: A quote-unquote violation.
sentences.zh: 所谓的违规。

sentences.en: However, we pressed him repeatedly on whether he would be willing to dismiss Mueller.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们一再逼问他是否愿意解雇穆勒。

sentences.en: What does the violation mean?
sentences.zh: 违规是什么意思？

sentences.en: What is that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: What is that violation?
sentences.zh: 那种违规是什么？

sentences.en: He wouldn't go there.
sentences.zh: 他对此避而不谈。

sentences.en: But what would you do?
sentences.zh: 但你会怎么做？

sentences.en: I can't answer that question because I don't think it's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我无法回答这个问题，因为我认为这不会发生。

sentences.en: He's clearly watching Mueller to see how far he'll go and in what directions and whether that's beyond Russia.
sentences.zh: 他显然在密切关注穆勒，看他会走多远、朝什么方向发展，以及这是否超出了俄罗斯的范畴。

sentences.en: So let's just keep going with the cast of characters in all of this.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们继续了解这里面的各色人物。

sentences.en: What did the president say during this interview about his attorney general, Jeff Sessions?
sentences.zh: 总统在这次采访中对他的总检察长杰夫·塞申斯说了什么？

sentences.en: He said...
sentences.zh: 他说……

sentences.en: Well, Sessions should have never recused himself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，塞申斯本不该回避的。

sentences.en: And if he would, if he was going to recuse himself, he should have told me before he took the job and I would have picked somebody else.
sentences.zh: 如果他要回避，他本应该在接任这份工作之前就告诉我，那我就会挑选别人了。

sentences.en: He gave you no heads up at all in any sense.
sentences.zh: 他完全没有给你任何事先的暗示。

sentences.en: Zero.
sentences.zh: 零。

sentences.en: He said that he never would have appointed him had he known that Sessions was going to recuse himself on Russia-related issues.
sentences.zh: 他说如果早知道塞申斯会在涉俄问题上回避，他绝不会任命他。

sentences.en: Wow, that is a...
sentences.zh: 哇，那是一个……

sentences.en: That's a big statement.
sentences.zh: 那是个重磅表态。

sentences.en: It's a big statement on the record.
sentences.zh: 这是一个公开的重磅表态。

sentences.en: So Jeff Sessions takes the job, gets into the job, recuses himself.
sentences.zh: 所以杰夫·塞申斯接了这份工作，上任后，选择了回避。

sentences.en: I then have...
sentences.zh: 然后我有了……

sentences.en: Which, frankly, I think is very unfair to the president.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我认为这对总统非常不公平。

sentences.en: How do you take a job and then recuse yourself?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能先接下一份工作，然后又选择回避呢？

sentences.en: If he would have recused himself before the job, I would have said, thanks, Jeff, but I can't...
sentences.zh: 如果他在接工作前就回避，我会说，谢谢你，杰夫，但我不能……

sentences.en: You know, I'm not going to thank you.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我不会感谢你的。

sentences.en: It's extremely unfair.
sentences.zh: 这极其不公平。

sentences.en: And that's a mild word to the president.
sentences.zh: 对总统来说，这还是个温和的词。

sentences.en: It's essentially saying that the attorney general shouldn't be the attorney general.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是在说，总检察长不配当总检察长。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And it could be seen as pretty undermining to his authority.
sentences.zh: 这可能被视为对他的权威极大的削弱。

sentences.en: I mean, what does it even mean to be an attorney general when the president of the United States,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当美利坚合众国总统、你的老板——

sentences.en: your boss, tells the New York Times that he would have never appointed you if you had done the thing that you thought was the right thing to do and that you did?
sentences.zh: 告诉《纽约时报》说，如果你做了你认为正确且确实做了的事，他绝不会任命你，那么担任总检察长究竟还有什么意义？

sentences.en: Well, I think it makes it very complicated for Jeff Sessions' path forward.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这让杰夫·塞申斯未来的道路变得非常复杂。

sentences.en: Maggie, at one point in this interview, which is veering from policy to politics to investigation, there's an interruption.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，在这次访谈中，话题在政策、政治和调查之间摇摆，期间发生了一个插曲。

sentences.en: But people didn't.
sentences.zh: 但人们并没有这样做。

sentences.en: We had a couple of people that said, hi, baby.
sentences.zh: 我们有几个人说，嗨，宝贝。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: My grandmother, this is Arabella, who speaks.
sentences.zh: 我的祖母，说话的是阿拉贝拉。

sentences.en: Say hello to them in Chinese.
sentences.zh: 用中文向他们打个招呼吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Is it Ivanka?
sentences.zh: 是伊万卡吗？

sentences.en: You know Ivanka?
sentences.zh: 你认识伊万卡？

sentences.en: At one point, Ivanka Trump and her daughter, Arabella, who just turned six, showed up in the doorway of the Oval.
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，伊万卡·特朗普和她刚满六岁的女儿阿拉贝拉出现在椭圆形办公室的门口。

sentences.en: Arabella ran into the room and she ran to her grandfather, who greeted her as baby, and gave her a kiss.
sentences.zh: 阿拉贝拉跑进房间，跑向她的祖父，祖父亲切地叫她宝贝，并亲吻了她。

sentences.en: And then he encouraged her to speak Chinese to us.
sentences.zh: 然后他鼓励她对我们说中文。

sentences.en: She speaks Chinese.
sentences.zh: 她会说中文。

sentences.en: She apparently speaks some Chinese.
sentences.zh: 她显然会说一些中文。

sentences.en: She speaks fluent Chinese.
sentences.zh: 她说流利的中文。

sentences.en: She's amazing.
sentences.zh: 她太棒了。

sentences.en: She spoke with President Xi.
sentences.zh: 她和习近平主席交谈过。

sentences.en: She went up to...
sentences.zh: 她走到……

sentences.en: Honey, can you say a few words in Chinese?
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，你能用中文说几句话吗？

sentences.en: Say, like, I love you, Grandpa.
sentences.zh: 比方说，我爱你，爷爷。

sentences.en: She's unbelievable, huh?
sentences.zh: 她真令人难以置信，对吧？

sentences.en: She has good, smart genes.
sentences.zh: 她有着优秀、聪明的基因。

sentences.en: It was impressive for a six-year-old to do that in front of strangers.
sentences.zh: 一个六岁的小孩在陌生人面前这样做，令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: It was an unexpected glimpse into kind of the grandfather, Trump.
sentences.zh: 这是一个意想不到的窥探，让人看到了作为祖父的特朗普的那一面。

sentences.en: Well, you're sitting there interviewing the president about really wey subjects.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你坐在那里采访总统，谈论的其实是沉重的话题。

sentences.en: Russia.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the cloud hits over his presidency.
sentences.zh: 阴云笼罩着他的总统任期。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, his cute granddaughter comes running in and he gives her a hug.
sentences.zh: 突然间，他可爱的孙女跑进来，他拥抱了她。

sentences.en: And it's like this incredible juxtaposition...
sentences.zh: 这就像是一种不可思议的并置……

sentences.en: It totally throws you off, I assume.
sentences.zh: 我猜这完全让你不知所措了吧。

sentences.en: ...of tender grandfatherness and the harsh reality of this Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: ……温柔的祖孙情与严酷的俄罗斯调查现实之间的并置。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Mike, did you feel satisfied by what the president told you on Russia?
sentences.zh: 迈克，总统关于俄罗斯对你所说的话，你感到满意吗？

sentences.en: And if you didn't, what do you still want him to answer?
sentences.zh: 如果你不满意，你还希望他回答什么？

sentences.en: I think as a journalist trying to understand the scope of what Mueller's investigation is and what may have happened, you're never satisfied.
sentences.zh: 我想作为一个试图理解穆勒调查范围以及可能发生的事情的记者，你永远不会满足。

sentences.en: It's interesting to hear him try and deconstruct his relationship with Comey and make sense of that,
sentences.zh: 听他试图解构他与科米的关系并试图厘清这一点，这很有意思，

sentences.en: because this is clearly something that has sideswiped him and really knocked him off track.
sentences.zh: 因为这显然是一件让他措手不及并真正打乱他阵脚的事情。

sentences.en: And has essentially given him Bob Mueller sitting there staring him down.
sentences.zh: 并且基本上给他招来了虎视眈眈的鲍勃·穆勒。

sentences.en: And you can see he's still trying to deal with that and he's saying, look, in retrospect, I look back on this meeting and I think this and this didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出他仍在努力应对这件事，他说，听着，回想起来，我回顾这次会面，我认为这发生了，那没有发生。

sentences.en: And so you see him trying to calibrate that and try and get his side out about that.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到他试图对此进行调整，并试图阐述他自己的立场。

sentences.en: As soon as he realized that we were going to listen to him and we were open to hearing what he was saying, that he was willing to talk and kept going.
sentences.zh: 一旦他意识到我们会倾听他的话，并且愿意听他讲述，他便愿意开口并继续说下去。

sentences.en: And it went on for, you know, it was a 50 minute interview.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道，采访持续了大约50分钟。

sentences.en: Mike, how exactly did the encounter end with the president?
sentences.zh: 迈克，与总统的这次会面究竟是怎么结束的？

sentences.en: One of the last things he says to us is, look, I'm doing a good job and please treat me fairly.
sentences.zh: 他对我们说的最后几句话之一是，听着，我干得很好，请公正地对待我。

sentences.en: I'm doing a good job.
sentences.zh: 我干得很好。

sentences.en: Just treat it fairly.
sentences.zh: 只需公正对待。

sentences.en: Because I can take everything I said and put a stupid spin on it or I can put a fair spin.
sentences.zh: 因为我可以把我所说的一切进行愚蠢的歪曲，或者我可以给出公正的解读。

sentences.en: Just treat it.
sentences.zh: 只需公正对待。

sentences.en: And we'll leave it in a couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们过几周再看吧。

sentences.en: Just let my words speak for themselves.
sentences.zh: 就让我的话不言自明吧。

sentences.en: And if you're fair to me, see you soon.
sentences.zh: 如果你对我公正，回见。

sentences.en: Sir, thank you.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，谢谢您。

sentences.en: Appreciate the time.
sentences.zh: 感谢您抽出时间。

sentences.en: Maggie, Michael, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 玛吉、迈克尔，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我们。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, a spokesman for Jeff Sessions declined to comment on the president's remarks.
sentences.zh: 周三晚间，杰夫·塞申斯的一位发言人拒绝就总统的言论发表评论。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普林。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个聚焦设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶时代的夜店当DJ时，每晚你都要带着300件你最珍爱的藏品去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个像是由精美的50年历史艺术品组成的快闪微型博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼表推出的《重构者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 人人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》应用，享受30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: Senator John McCain has been diagnosed with brain cancer.
sentences.zh: 参议员约翰·麦凯恩被诊断出患有脑癌。

sentences.en: The tumor was discovered following surgery for a blood clot above McCain's left eye,
sentences.zh: 这个肿瘤是在对麦凯恩左眼上方的血栓进行手术后发现的，

sentences.en: which delayed a Senate vote on the Republican health care bill before its ultimate collapse on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 这推迟了参议院对共和党医疗保健法案的投票，该法案最终于周二流产。

sentences.en: The 80-year-old senator has represented Arizona since 1983, first as a member of the House of Representatives, and
sentences.zh: 这位80岁的参议员自1983年起代表亚利桑那州，最初担任众议院议员，并且

sentences.en: Welcome to the inaugural meeting of the Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到总统选举诚信咨询委员会的首次会议。

sentences.en: The commission set up by President Trump to investigate whether voter fraud cost him the popular vote
sentences.zh: 这个由特朗普总统设立、旨在调查选民欺诈是否让他失去普选票的委员会

sentences.en: held its first meeting on Wednesday, amid lawsuits challenging the legality of its work and the absence of any evidence that widespread illegal voting occurred.
sentences.zh: 于周三举行了第一次会议，正值挑战其工作合法性的诉讼不断，且没有任何证据表明发生过广泛的非法投票。

sentences.en: This commission has no preconceived notions or preordained results.
sentences.zh: 该委员会没有先入为主的观念，也没有预先注定的结果。

sentences.en: We're fact finders.
sentences.zh: 我们是事实调查员。

sentences.en: Despite broad resistance and complaints from state election officials, the commission's chairman, Vice President Mike Pence,
sentences.zh: 尽管遭到各州选举官员的广泛抵制和投诉，但委员会主席、副总统迈克·彭斯

sentences.en: said that more than 30 states had ultimately agreed to share data on their voters with the commission.
sentences.zh: 表示，最终有30多个州同意与委员会共享其选民数据。

sentences.en: President Trump said that was not sufficient.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示这还不够。

sentences.en: If any state does not want to share this information, one has to wonder what they're worried about.
sentences.zh: 如果哪个州不想分享这些信息，人们不禁要问他们在担心什么。

sentences.en: And I asked the vice president, I asked the commission, what are they worried about?
sentences.zh: 我问了副总统，我问了委员会，他们在担心什么？

sentences.en: There's something.
sentences.zh: 总有点猫腻。

sentences.en: There always is.
sentences.zh: 向来如此。

sentences.en: That's it for The Deal.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《交易》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbour.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴伯。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一群自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱且有时惊心动魄的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我主持的新一期《都市》节目中，由我萨拉·科尼格为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
